634fe8d61c272281.description: About Asteri Beauty (B Corp™) Asteri Beauty (B Corp™) is seeking a Demand Supply Planner to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This role involves close collaboration with multiple internal teams to align forecasts with business strategies and maintain product availability. Key Responsibilities: Demand Planning Develop, implement, and manage 12-18 month demand forecasts at channel, category, account, and item levels. Recommend actions to achieve target levels. Lead monthly Integrated Business Planning (IBP) / Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) forecast reviews. Participate in cross-functional meetings to align demand forecasts with business strategies, involving finance, marketing, supply chain, and sales teams. Analyze historical sales data, market trends, and promotional activities to assess product and category performance. Ensure trends are accurately captured in item-level demand plans, including base item and promotional forecasting, event planning, and weekly/monthly performance analysis and insights. Ensure stock availability across all locations, managing inbound warehouse replenishment from suppliers, outbound store replenishment, and outbound sell-in to B2B customers. Act as a trusted partner and the primary point of contact between stakeholders and Roche. Provide patient care at a subspecialist level, adhering to delineated services and granted privileges. This includes consultations, follow-up care, procedures, and on-call duties in various settings such as outpatient clinics, inpatient wards, emergency rooms, and intensive care units. Comply with KAAUH quality improvement initiatives, ensuring a safe healing environment and meeting hospital accreditation requirements. 63121ef3c35571a6.description: About alfanar Electric alfanar, headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, is a diversified company with operations in construction, manufacturing, design, and development across the Middle East and other countries. The company is active in Electrical, Electromechanical, and Civil Engineering Construction, manufacturing and marketing electrical construction products, and providing allied engineering services. alfanar Electric serves as the industrial arm of alfanar, specializing in the manufacturing of low, medium, and high voltage electrical construction products. Its industrial facilities are located in Riyadh and Al Jubail, Saudi Arabia; Dubai, UAE; and London, UK. alfanar also maintains a development and engineering center in Chennai, India. The primary hub for alfanar’s industrial activities is the alfanar Industrial Complex in Riyadh, spanning 700,000 square meters and housing comprehensive infrastructure. Role Overview alfanar Electric is seeking a Sr. HSE Engineer to provide advanced technical support for Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) across assigned areas. This full-time role involves conducting risk assessments, performing inspections, investigating incidents, and verifying operational controls during day or night shifts. The Sr. HSE Engineer will contribute to strengthening compliance, emergency readiness, and technical competency through guidance, analysis, and effective shift handover processes in Riyadh and Al Jubail, Saudi Arabia. The position requires 6-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Conduct complex risk assessments, including ATEX/hazardous-area classification, machinery safety, chemical exposure, and fire risks, and develop appropriate assessment methodologies. Review assessments prepared by engineers and inspectors, verifying the adequacy of proposed mitigation measures. Assess HSE controls for contractor activities, maintenance, shutdowns, projects, and production line modifications. Support occupational exposure assessments and verify environmental controls for chemicals, waste, and spill prevention. Develop inspection schedules and conduct planned patrols of high-risk areas during assigned shifts, providing technical guidance on inspection priorities. Participate in cross-factory audits and conduct ISO 45001/14001 internal audits as assigned. Verify permit-to-work, hot work, and lockout/tagout compliance for operational, maintenance, and contractor activities, identifying deviations from approved procedures. Verify valid third-party certification of regulated equipment and required operator licenses, exercising stop-work authority when unsafe conditions present unacceptable risk. Investigate serious and high-potential incidents using advanced root cause analysis methods and recommend actions to address underlying causes. Provide immediate incident response, coordinate with emergency teams, secure the scene for investigation, and escalate serious incidents to the HSE Manager without delay. Maintain area emergency response arrangements and participate in drills aligned with Civil Defense requirements. Coach engineers and inspectors, contribute to competency assessments, and develop structured technical development plans. Develop training materials and deliver awareness campaigns, toolbox talks, and technical training, including for permit issuers and receivers. Develop improvements to inspection methods, digital reporting, and operational controls, benchmarking good practices and measuring their impact. Analyze HSE findings, incident trends, and KPIs, presenting findings and technical recommendations to stakeholders. Track corrective actions through closure and verify their effectiveness. Prepare shift HSE reports and manage handover of incidents, significant risks, and outstanding actions between day and night teams to ensure continuity of HSE coverage. Accountabilities and Compliance Maintain updated soft and technical skills relevant to the job. Perform planned activities to meet operational and development targets as per delivery schedules, utilizing resources effectively within cost and time constraints. Provide periodic reports detailing deviations and execution of planned tasks. Solve related problems and escalate complex operational issues. Ensure quality requirements are met to develop effective quality control and processes, including specifications for products, processes, or related activities. Coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, procedures, and seek automation opportunities. Comply with relevant policies, procedures, and work instructions. Ensure compliance with relevant safety, quality, and environmental management procedures and controls within the defined area of work activity. Experience and Work Type This is a full-time position requiring 6-10 years of experience in a relevant HSE role. The successful candidate will be based in either Riyadh or Al Jubail, Saudi Arabia, and will be expected to work day or night shifts as assigned to ensure continuous HSE coverage.

63856174e8148e3c.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مصنع القمه للاثاث والديكورات الخشبيه عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقه في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة العمليات المالية، من إعداد مستندات الصرف ومتابعة الإيرادات إلى إعداد التقارير والوثائق المحاسبية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال المحاسبي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد وتنظيم مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تحصيل الإيرادات وتوثيقها وتحليلها. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات. تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتعلقة بالنفقات والإيرادات وحفظها. تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من اكتمال شروطها القانونية والمالية. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بناءً على الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، وإعداد وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطور العلمي والتقني في هذا المجال. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المحاسبة. فهم قوي للمبادئ والمعايير المحاسبية. القدرة على إعداد التقارير المالية وتحليل البيانات. المهارات والكفاءات الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في التعامل مع المستندات والبيانات المالية. مهارات تنظيمية ممتازة للتعامل مع السجلات والوثائق. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. مهارات تواصل فعالة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن مصنع القمه للاثاث والديكورات الخشبيه. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بالعمل المكتبي وإدارة المهام المحاسبية اليومية بكفاءة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

636bb794859922a7.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المدينه المنوره لنقل الحجاج عن سائق شاحنة صغيرة للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان نقل الحجاج والمعتمرين والزوار بأمان وفعالية، مع الالتزام بالمسارات والجداول الزمنية المعتمدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى سائق الشاحنة الصغيرة مسؤولية قيادة المركبة بأمان والالتزام بالتعليمات التشغيلية، وتشمل مهامه ما يلي: قيادة الشاحنة الصغيرة لنقل الركاب بأمان وفق المسارات والجداول المحددة. التقيد بأنظمة المرور والسرعات المحددة، والقيادة بسلاسة لتجنب التوقف أو التجاوز المفاجئ. الامتناع التام عن استخدام الهاتف الجوال أثناء القيادة وربط حزام الأمان. إجراء الفحص اليومي للشاحنة، بما في ذلك الفرامل والإطارات والأنوار ومستوى الوقود، قبل كل رحلة. التأكد من جاهزية أجهزة السلامة مثل مطفأة الحريق وحقيبة الإسعافات الأولية. الإبلاغ الفوري عن أي أعطال ميكانيكية لمركز الصيانة. الالتزام بجدول الرحلة ومواعيد التوقف والوصول المحددة. استقبال الركاب بأسلوب مهذب وتقديم المساعدة اللازمة، خاصة لكبار السن وذوي الإعاقة. التأكد من مطابقة تذاكر الركاب أو صعود الفئات المصرح لها فقط. الحفاظ على نظافة الشاحنة وتشغيل التكييف والإضاءة المناسبة لضمان بيئة مريحة. تفقد الشاحنة بعد كل رحلة للتأكد من خلوها من الركاب والتعامل مع المفقودات. المؤهلات والخبرات لشغل هذا المنصب، يجب أن يمتلك المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال قيادة الشاحنات الصغيرة أو الحافلات. معرفة جيدة بأنظمة المرور والسلامة على الطرق. القدرة على التعامل مع الركاب بأسلوب مهذب واحترافي. الالتزام بالمواعيد والجداول الزمنية. القدرة على إجراء الفحوصات الأساسية للمركبة والإبلاغ عن الأعطال. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مكة المكرمة، وتتطلب الوظيفة العمل بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة المدينه المنوره لنقل الحجاج. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

The company designs, builds, and operates cloud and AI environments for customers across major technology platforms, independent of technology stack or deployment model. The successful candidate will build and manage executive-level customer relationships, collaborating with technical, delivery, and business stakeholders to develop solutions for complex business challenges. This is a consultative, hunter-oriented role requiring proactive opportunity creation and pipeline development, engaging senior decision-makers within enterprise organizations. Success will be measured by generating net-new business, building a sustainable pipeline, consistently exceeding revenue targets, and establishing Rackspace as a strategic partner in key enterprise accounts. Key Responsibilities Manage the full sales cycle, from prospecting and qualification through negotiation, close, and ongoing account growth. Develop and execute account plans, including pursuit strategies, timelines, deliverables, and revenue objectives for assigned accounts. Maintain a territory and portfolio strategy that prioritizes high-value opportunities. Identify and develop new business opportunities through proactive outbound prospecting, networking, referrals, and partner engagement. Collaborate with Marketing and Business Development Representatives (BDRs) on targeted campaigns and sales plays. Lead the sales process across the Rackspace solutions portfolio. Build relationships with key stakeholders and executive decision-makers within target accounts. Qualify customer opportunities, identify business drivers, and align Rackspace solutions with customer objectives. Conduct discovery sessions to understand customer challenges, priorities, and transformation goals. Partner with Sales Engineers and technical specialists to assess customer environments and define solution strategies. Develop compelling proposals, business cases, and value propositions. Lead negotiations, contract discussions, renewals, and commercial reviews. Drive strategic pursuits aligned with territorial objectives and company growth strategy. Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Delivery, Support, Customer Success, and Partner teams. Proactively identify and resolve obstacles impacting sales opportunities and customer success. Build and maintain a robust pipeline to consistently achieve and exceed quota. Represent Rackspace at executive meetings, industry events, partner engagements, and customer workshops. Required Experience and Qualifications 5-10 years of quota-carrying enterprise sales experience in technology, cloud, managed services, AI, data, or digital transformation. Demonstrated track record of generating net-new pipeline and acquiring new enterprise customers. Proven experience selling cloud, data, AI, cybersecurity, infrastructure, or digital transformation solutions. Credibility in engaging C-level executives and senior business stakeholders. Evidence of personally creating opportunities rather than relying primarily on inbound demand. Strong ability to connect technology investments to tangible business, financial, and operational outcomes. Experience managing complex, consultative enterprise sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders. Strong executive presence, commercial acumen, negotiation, and relationship-building skills. Demonstrated success selling high-value, multi-year managed services or transformation engagements. 635844c8c6852770.description: As a Database Administrator, you ll take ownership of the health and operational reliability of our production databases. You ll work on challenges that go beyond routine administration, including multi-terabyte database environments, high-availability architecture, disaster recovery, major-version upgrades, and safe database migrations. You ll also work closely with engineering, cloud, and reliability teams to help developers make better database decisions, prevent production incidents, and improve the way database changes are designed and delivered. If you enjoy solving complex database performance challenges, building resilient data infrastructure, and taking ownership of critical production systems, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact. What You ll Do Manage and maintain PostgreSQL and MySQL databases across AWS, GCP, and self-managed environments. Monitor database performance, availability, and capacity. Optimize queries, indexing, and database resource utilization. Manage backups, point-in-time recovery, and disaster recovery. Implement database replication, high availability, and failover strategies. Plan database upgrades, migrations, and safe schema changes. Maintain database security, access controls, and auditing. Automate database operations using Bash, Python, or similar tools. Troubleshoot database incidents and perform root-cause analysis. Collaborate with engineering, DevOps, SRE, and Cloud teams to improve database reliability and scalability. You understand the existing database architecture, operational workflows, monitoring, and recovery procedures. You ve built strong working relationships with the database team, Cloud Engineering, SRE, and development teams. You ve identified the most significant risks and improvement opportunities across availability, performance, backup, and recovery. By day 60: You re independently handling assigned database administration and troubleshooting activities. You ve reviewed backup configurations and started validating recovery procedures for critical databases. You ve identified gaps in database monitoring and alerting, including replication lag, WAL contention, autovacuum, and table bloat. You re contributing to database performance improvements and operational documentation. By day 90: Critical database restore tests have been completed or are progressing against an agreed recovery-testing plan, with gaps documented and corrective actions defined. Key database failure scenarios are documented through practical runbooks. Database monitoring and alerting improvements have been implemented for prioritized operational risks. You re actively contributing to database reliability, performance, and incident-prevention initiatives. By day 120: A safer database change-management process is in place, including appropriate reviews, DDL auditing, and rollback planning. A practical PostgreSQL major-upgrade roadmap has been developed, with compatibility and migration risks assessed. The high-availability approach for the SITE database environment has been evaluated and documented. Database size and activity metrics are available to support the per-customer cost-allocation initiative. Nice to Have (but not required) Experience with multi-tenant database architectures, particularly schema-per-tenant environments with thousands of schemas. Experience managing databases larger than several terabytes with high write volumes and demanding availability requirements. Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL tooling such as Patroni, pgBackRest, or WAL-G. Experience supporting cloud migrations or moving customer workloads to in-Kingdom hosting environments. Familiarity with database observability, capacity planning, and per-customer database usage or cost allocation. Experience working in SaaS, data-platform, fintech, banking, or telecommunications environments. Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools and automated database provisioning. Relevant certifications, such as EDB PostgreSQL or AWS certifications. What the hiring process will look like Mawhub screening Technical screen (45 min) [DB Lead] Technical deep-dive (60 90 min) with a practical scenario: diagnosing replication lag and WAL contention, planning a zero-downtime major upgrade [DB Lead + SRE Team Lead] Hiring manager interview Mahmoud Moharam, Cloud Manager Culture fit interview - HR Director Desired Candidate Profile Who You Are You re an experienced Database Administrator who understands that managing production databases is about more than keeping services running. You know how to prevent data loss, diagnose complex performance problems, plan high-risk changes, and build systems that remain reliable under pressure. You re comfortable working with large, business-critical databases and can balance operational stability with the need to improve architecture, automation, and scalability. Technically, you likely: Have 5+ years of hands-on PostgreSQL administration experience in production. Have experience with AWS Aurora, Amazon RDS, MySQL, and self-managed Linux databases. Understand database performance tuning, replication, high availability, and disaster recovery. Have experience managing multi-terabyte databases, upgrades, and migrations. Can automate database operations using Bash or Python. When it comes to database resilience: You have hands-on experience with backups, recovery, replication, and failover. You can troubleshoot database incidents and minimize downtime. You follow safe change-management practices and maintain rollback plans. When it comes to database performance: You can troubleshoot slow queries, indexing, locking, and resource utilization. You understand PostgreSQL internals and multi-tenant database challenges. What sets you apart: You take ownership and remain calm under pressure. You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with engineering teams. You document your work and continuously improve database reliability.

This role is within the company's Environmental & Sustainability initiatives, an extension of the Industrial Facilities vertical, focusing on delivering circular-economy and decarbonization infrastructure for the Kingdom. The Project Manager will lead the end-to-end delivery of the BST-06 MAX pyrolysis biochar plant at the SBF site in Riyadh, a flagship environmental and sustainability initiative. Manage punch lists and close out civil and mechanical snags. Oversee initial operations to confirm safe plant performance within its approved footprint. Manage infrastructure modifications, access road maintenance, containment areas, and ongoing HSE coordination. Lead formal handover to the operations team with full documentation. Complete as-built documentation, lessons-learned register, financial reconciliation, and contractual closeout. Develop and maintain the Project Management Plan, Scope Statement, and Work Breakdown Structure (WBS). Manage change control through a formal change request and approval process. Serve as the primary interface between Front End, the client (SBF), the equipment supplier (Beston Group), and regulatory authorities. Develop and maintain the master construction program (MS Project or Primavera P6) aligned with the June 2026 commissioning target. Track critical-path activities, manage float, and report schedule variance weekly. Manage the project budget; track committed vs. actual cost. Approve subcontractor invoices and variation orders within delegated authority. Report cost performance (CPI/SPI) to the Project Director monthly. Implement Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) for civil, structural, and mechanical works. Ensure compliance with KSA building codes, SASO standards, Beston Group specifications, and ISO 9001 quality principles. Conduct daily site inspections; maintain photographic records of all construction milestones. Lead and direct subcontractors engaged in earthworks, concrete, steelwork, mechanical, and utilities installation. Coordinate temporary site services: site office, welfare, security fencing, material storage. Produce weekly progress reports, monthly stakeholder dashboards, and written daily site logs. Chair weekly project coordination meetings and monthly steering committee reviews. Maintain the Project Risk & Issues Register; escalate geotechnical, structural, regulatory, or schedule risks promptly. Develop mitigation plans for high-priority risks; review register weekly. Manage subcontractor contracts, scope, and performance. Coordinate with the supplier (Beston Group) on warranty, spares, and technical support obligations. Liaise with Saudi authorities for site permits, environmental operating licenses, and industrial area compliance. Coordinate with SBF facilities management on power supply, access routes, water/drainage tie-ins, and waste management. Manage client relationships and expectations throughout the lifecycle. Ensure all site activities comply with KSA municipal environmental regulations and SBF site-specific HSE requirements. Oversee lifting plans, toolbox talks, permit-to-work systems, and incident reporting. Champion sustainability outcomes consistent with the project's environmental mission. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of relevant experience. Demonstrated leadership and decision-making capabilities under pressure. Experience in stakeholder management across multicultural and multi-organizational teams. Proficiency in problem-solving and conflict resolution. Strong commercial and contractual awareness. Commitment to safety and environmental stewardship. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Authorities Approve site-level technical decisions within the scope of the approved design. Escalate scope, schedule, cost, or risk exceptions to the Project Director. Project Context This project involves the design, civil construction, installation, commissioning, and operational handover of a pyrolysis biochar production unit. The plant will divert organic and agricultural residues from landfill, produce biochar for soil regeneration and carbon sequestration, and generate renewable syngas as a process energy source. It will operate within KSA municipal environmental regulations and SBF site-specific HSE standards. The project also serves as a reference deployment for Front End's broader sustainability portfolio.

6378fd7098ad585b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة القسي العالمية للمقاولات عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في خميس مشيط، عسير. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات، وهو مخصص للعمل بدوام كامل. سيقوم المهندس المدني بدراسة المواقع الإنشائية، إعداد التصاميم والمخططات، والإشراف على تنفيذ المشاريع لضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طبوغرافية وجيولوجية الموقع الإنشائي ونتائج اختبار فحص التربة. دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية للمشروع. تحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة للمشروع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصره. إعداد تصاميم المشروع ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها. تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات للمواد الإنشائية. الإشراف على تنفيذ المشروع ومطابقة المواصفات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسبة تقدمها. عرض وتوضيح التقارير وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة المطلوبة يتطلب هذا الدور مرشحاً يمتلك خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة المدنية والمقاولات. يجب أن يكون المرشح قادراً على تطبيق المعرفة الهندسية في تحليل المواقع، التصميم الإنشائي، والإشراف على التنفيذ بفعالية. بيئة العمل سيعمل المهندس المدني ضمن فريق شركة القسي العالمية للمقاولات في مدينة خميس مشيط بمنطقة عسير. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع لمتابعة سير المشاريع والإشراف عليها. التقديم الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. للمهتمين، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم للانضمام إلى فريق عملنا في شركة القسي العالمية للمقاولات.
